description: Differential expression from raw RNA-seq read counts, by one of the three standard count models. DESeq2 (Love, Huber & Anders 2014): median-of-ratios size factors, negative-binomial GLM with empirical-Bayes shrunken dispersions, Wald or likelihood-ratio test, Cook's-distance outlier handling, independent filtering, optional LFC shrinkage. edgeR quasi-likelihood (Chen et al. 2025): filterByExpr, TMM normalization, a negative-binomial GLM with bias-adjusted QL dispersions squeezed toward an abundance trend, QL F-test. limma-voom (Law et al. 2014): filterByExpr, TMM, log-CPM with mean-variance precision weights, weighted linear models, moderated t. Takes a gene-by-sample count table and a sample table with the design's variables. Every gene of every validated fit is bit-identical to DESeq2 1.52.0, edgeR 4.10.6 and limma 3.68.5 running in R. Hands its significant genes, tested genes and ranked list on for gene-set enrichment.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alpha.description: the target FDR: the summary counts genes below this adjusted p, and DESeq2's independent filtering maximizes rejections at it.

altHypothesis.description: which side of the threshold is the alternative. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

avgTxLength.description: optional: tximport's average transcript lengths (txi$length), the same genes and samples as `counts`. DESeq2 then normalizes by gene-by-sample factors (each gene's lengths over their geometric mean, times median-of-ratios size factors), correcting for changes in transcript usage between samples. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

betaPrior.description: DESeq2's pre-1.16 default: a zero-mean Normal prior on every level's log2 fold change, so the reported fold changes, SEs and Wald test are the shrunken (MAP) ones. Wald only, no interactions; use instead of `shrink`. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

blind.description: fit the transformation's dispersion trend under ~ 1, blind to the design (DESeq2's default, for quality assessment); off reuses the fitted design and trend, for downstream use when large differences between groups are expected. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

contrast.description: 'factor, numerator, denominator': the log2 fold change of numerator over denominator. Empty is the design's last coefficient. Under edgeR and voom the denominator must be the factor's reference level.

cooksCutoff.description: the Cook's distance cutoff; empty is DESeq2's F(0.99; p, m - p). Only applies when method is DESeq2.

cooksFilter.description: set the p-value of genes with a Cook's-distance outlier to NA. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

counts.description: raw read counts (never normalized values or TPM): genes in rows with the gene ID first, samples in columns, tab- or comma-separated, a header row naming the samples.

design.description: the design formula over the sample table's columns, the variable of interest last (e.g. '~ batch + condition').

filterByExpr.description: keep only genes edgeR's filterByExpr finds expressed (the edgeR and limma workflows' first step); off fits every gene. Only applies when method is edgeR-QL or limma-voom.

fitType.description: the dispersion trend: parametric (asymptDisp + extraPois / mean, DESeq2's default, which falls back to local when it does not fit), local (locfit regression of log dispersion on log mean), the mean of gene-wise estimates, or glmGamPoi (gene-wise maximum likelihood by glmGamPoi, a local-median trend and quasi-likelihood shrinkage; with test LRT the p-values are glmGamPoi's quasi-likelihood F test; no outlier replacement, minmu 1e-6, no observation weights). Only applies when method is DESeq2.

independentFiltering.description: drop low-mean genes from the adjustment when that gains rejections at `alpha`. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

lfcThreshold.description: test |log2 fold change| against this threshold instead of 0. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

method.description: the count model: DESeq2 (negative binomial, Wald or LRT), edgeR-QL (negative binomial with quasi-likelihood F-test) or limma-voom (precision-weighted linear model on log-CPM, moderated t).

minCount.description: filterByExpr: the count, at the median library size, a gene needs in the smallest group's worth of samples (taken as CPM). Only applies when method is edgeR-QL or limma-voom.

minReplicatesForReplace.description: samples per group from which outlier counts are replaced and the gene refitted, instead of flagged. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

minTotalCount.description: filterByExpr: the total count a gene needs across all samples. Only applies when method is edgeR-QL or limma-voom.

minmu.description: the floor on fitted means in the GLM and the dispersion fit; empty is DESeq2's default, 0.5, or 1e-6 with fitType glmGamPoi. Single-cell counts, often below 1, want a small value such as 1e-6 (zinbwave's vignette). Only applies when method is DESeq2.

name.description: one fitted coefficient to report, by its DESeq2 name (e.g. 'condition_treated_vs_untreated') or its model-matrix column ('conditiontreated'); empty is the last.

pcaGroup.description: plotPCA's intgroup: the sample-table variables, separated by commas, that colour the samples (joined with ':' when more than one); empty is the factor of the reported comparison. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

pcaTop.description: plotPCA's ntop: the PCA uses this many genes with the largest variance of the transformed values. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

reduced.description: the reduced design for the likelihood-ratio test. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

reference.description: reference level per factor, 'variable=level' separated by commas; a factor not named takes its alphabetically first level, as R does.

samples.description: the sample table: a header row, then one row per sample with its name (as in the count table's header) first and the design's variables after; the run uses this table's sample order.

sfType.description: size factors: median of ratios over genes with no zero (ratio), with zeros allowed (poscounts, for sparse data), or iterated to maximise the NB likelihood of all but the worst-fitting 5% of genes (iterate, when every gene has a zero). Only applies when method is DESeq2.

shrink.description: shrink the reported coefficient's or contrast's log2 fold changes toward zero where the counts cannot support them (DESeq2 lfcShrink), for ranking and plotting by effect size; p-values stay the unshrunken test's. apeglm: adaptive Cauchy prior, posterior mode (a coefficient only). ashr: mixture-of-normals prior, posterior mean. normal: DESeq2's original zero-centred Normal prior (Wald only), a contrast on the expanded model matrix. With lfcThreshold, apeglm and ashr give s-values of a false sign or a fold change inside the threshold, and normal re-tests the shrunken fit. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

test.description: Wald: one coefficient or contrast. LRT: the full design against `reduced`, testing every removed term at once. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

transform.description: the count transformation the sample-level checks (PCA, sample distances) run on: vst (DESeq2's variance stabilizing transformation, the trend fitted on 1,000 genes; with fewer than 1,000 genes above a mean of 5 use VST), VST (varianceStabilizingTransformation, every gene), rlog (regularized log, a per-gene ridge fit, slow above ~30 samples) or normTransform (log2 of normalized count + 1, no stabilization). none skips the checks. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

useT.description: Wald p-values from a Student t on each gene's summed weights (or the sample count) minus the coefficients, instead of the normal: zinbwave's recommendation for weighted single-cell data. Wald test only. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

weights.description: optional: observation weights (assays(dds)[["weights"]]), the same genes and samples as `counts`, e.g. zinbwave's posterior probability that a single-cell count is not a dropout. DESeq2 divides each gene's weights by their largest and uses them in the base means, the dispersion likelihoods (samples at or below 0.01 leave the Cox-Reid term), the GLM and its tests. Only applies when method is DESeq2.

name: differential_expression

dispersionPlot.description: DESeq2: gene-wise, fitted and final dispersions against mean count. edgeR: quarter-root raw, squeezed and trend QL dispersions against average log2 CPM (plotQLDisp). voom: sqrt standard deviation against log2 count size, with the lowess trend that sets the weights

downGenes.description: significant genes with negative log2 fold change, one per line

genes.description: one row per gene: log2FoldChange, stat (DESeq2 Wald or LRT, edgeR F, voom moderated t), pvalue, padj, why padj is NA, the normalized counts per sample; DESeq2 adds baseMean, lfcSE, the gene-wise, fitted and final dispersions, whether it was refitted and with `shrink` the shrunken fold change, its SE and s-value (normal with lfcThreshold: the shrunken fit's p-value and padj); edgeR and voom add logCPM, the raw, prior and posterior variance (edgeR's QL dispersion) and the total df, and voom the B-statistic

maPlot.description: log2 fold change (shrunken, with `shrink`) against mean normalized count (DESeq2) or average log2 CPM (edgeR, voom), significant genes apart

meanCounts.description: DESeq2 runs only (empty under edgeR and voom): every tested gene with its mean normalized count (baseMean), 'gene value' per line: the gene weights for a Wallenius-weighted over-representation test, which corrects for the extra power to call well-counted genes

rankedList.description: tested genes by their test statistic, decreasing: DESeq2's Wald statistic, voom's moderated t, or edgeR's signed square root of F (a t with the same df): the ranked list for GSEA

sampleDistances.description: DESeq2 runs only (null under edgeR and voom): the sample checks as data: the transformation and its trend, the PCA genes, percentVar, PC1 and PC2 per sample, the sample-to-sample Euclidean distance matrix over every gene and its complete-linkage clustering (leaf order, merges, heights), as the vignette's heatmap draws it; or why the checks could not run

samplePca.description: DESeq2 runs only (null under edgeR and voom): plotPCA on the transformed counts (`transform`, `blind`): PC2 against PC1 per sample, one series per `pcaGroup` level, each axis labelled with its share of the variance

significantGenes.description: genes with padj below alpha, one per line: the gene list for over-representation analysis

summary.description: genes up and down at alpha and tested, with the method's own fit: DESeq2's outliers, low counts, filter threshold, size factors, dispersion trend and shrinkage prior; edgeR's common and average QL dispersion and prior df; voom's span and prior variance; the filterByExpr cutoffs and library sizes

testedGenes.description: every gene with an adjusted p-value, one per line: the background (universe) for over-representation analysis

upGenes.description: significant genes with positive log2 fold change, one per line

volcano.description: -log10 p against log2 fold change, significant genes apart
